title: Foxconn says third quarter to outperform market expectations on AI strength
title_zh: 富士康表示第三季度人工智能实力超出市场预期
summary: TAIPEI, Sept 5 (Reuters) - Foxconn's third-quarter performance is expected to outperform market expectations given strong AI-related demand, the Taiwanese contract electronics maker said on Saturday,
summary_zh: 路透台北 9 月 5 日 - 台湾合约电子产品制造商富士康周六表示，鉴于人工智能相关需求强劲，预计第三季度业绩将超出市场预期。
